name: Seven Stars 3D 2
storyline: The Big Dipper was hidden again by an evil monster. Human being lost their guide in the night. you need to find your way by maneuvering through the labyrinth with steady hands and sharp reflexes to save the Seven stars!
summary: Tilt your device to move a ball trough a platforming maze to complete levels in this sequel to the first Seven Stars 3D game.
